context: Ongoing: Six-axis sensor drifts with temperature and bolt preload. This week: Mei: Fz zero drifts ~12 N over a 20 min run.
Ongoing: Capacitive tactile array crosstalk and flex cable routing through the finger. This week: Jonas adds per-taxel baseline calibration; Kenji wants a respin anyway.
Ongoing: Crossed-roller preload drops after thermal cycling; bore tolerance and preload ring design. This week: Spacer stack chosen; bore tolerance tightened on the housing drawing to +0.008/-0.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists. This week: Marcus: show the leg on the gantry plus hip and hand separately; no torso.
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis. This week: First drops at 15 cm fine; 30 cm drop leaves a crack at the shank clevis fillet.
